trials.name: a read past the end of the image is an error instead of zero
the window reads from the start regardless of the offset asked for
a negative offset is accepted rather than refused

_comment: The image-window reader. Verified by the Rust test rather than by rebuilding the wasm and running the TypeScript bridge: the trials mutate Rust, the Rust test asserts the same three properties, and a rebuild per trial cost ten minutes a run. The bridge's parity test still runs in the ordinary suite; it is not this spec's verifier.
